newsitem.title: USA: Ricoh establishes Silicon Valley group.
newsitem.headline: Ricoh establishes Silicon Valley group.

text.p: Ricoh Co., Ltd. launched a new business development and research facility in the center of Silicon Valley, including a new unit to form strategic alliances and make equity investments.

"We have come to Silicon Valley because there is no other place in the world like it," Ricoh president Masamitsu Sakurai said in remarks prepared for the launch event, which included leading high tech entrepreneurs.
"Its technological vitality, willingness to take business risks and ability to imagine the future are unique and admirable. We want to infuse Ricoh with this sprit," he said.

The new subsidiary - dubbed Ricoh Silicon Valley, Inc. - includes Ricoh's California Research Center, which has been conducting applied research here for more than eight years and employs about 20 people.

Stephen Weyl, formerly vice president of network services integration at International Business Machines Corp., will direct the new Strategic Business Center, which he said has a first year fund of $10 million for an expected five to six equity investments.
Weyl said the investments would be specifically targeted at "simple, effective and affordable solutions" for the small business market.
The market includes six million offices in Japan and at least 7.7 million companies in the United States with fewer than 20 workers.

These firms account for 99.7 percent of all U.S. companies and employ 58 million Americans, or 53 percent of the workforce, while producing 50 percent of the U.S. gross national product, according to Ricoh.

"We are very strategically focused," Weyl said in an interview, adding the group will be looking to leverage Ricoh's strong optics and facsimile technology, for example, as well as its powerful distribution in Japan.

On the laboratory side, some work will be done at Menlo Park, some by outside research and development teams, and some at Ricoh's Japanese facilities. ((sam.perry@reuters.com, Palo Alto Bureau 415 846 5400))
